mentions.name: elmo
mentions.description: This tool automatically builds a searchable knowledge base around a coding project based on the developer's conversations with AI coding tools. It runs without requiring attention, reusing the same underlying tool (Claude/Codex/Gemini) and its quota so there is no additional AI cost, and outputs an ./elmodocs directory in the project root that can be referenced from CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md or included directly in the coding context.
mentions.problem: Building a knowledge base around a coding project normally requires manual attention and extra AI spend; elmo works automatically and reuses the developer's existing coding-tool quota.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://elmo.dev - a tool that automatically builds a searchable knowledge base around your project based on your conversation with coding tools.
